name: Interview process review after a hiring round
summary: After a hiring round closes, the recruiting lead gets a review of the interview process: questions that gave no usable evidence, competencies nobody covered, inconsistent rubric use, and revisions to approve before the next search. It reviews the process only; no candidate is assessed.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of recruiting work, and its own method for reviewing an interview process after a round: fixed input columns, rules for judging a note usable, coverage and rubric-use checks, stop conditions, tests and a worked example.
